liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **first notes of St. Stephen**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **St. Stephen attempt into William Tell Transition**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **St. Stephen attempt into William Tell Transition**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **St. Stephen attempt into William Tell Transition**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **William Tell**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 9 archived performances [10]
- **fast aborted Eleven**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **Jerry Describes William Tell transition**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **Burp! (sounds like Phil)...Jerry plays the Drums to Show Billy Triplets**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1968-11-06.StudioRehearsals.GEMS.82393.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 29 songs; 82 min; rated 3/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: Vocals are barely audible in the mix; keyboard sounds like Tim Constanten [5]
- **gd1968-11-06.154387.studios.rehearsals.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 7 songs; 82 min [2]
- **gd1968-11-06.153017.sbd.gans.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 7 songs; 82 min [3]

## Around the show

- First part is repetitive until Phil starts leading the jam [5]
- Band plays the Aoxomoxoa arrangement; Pigpen seems absent [5]
- Billy explains drum triplets to Mickey, who emulates the rolls [7]
- Phil notes the band is dropping the beat on subdivisions [1]
- Numerous stop and starts occur during the rehearsal session [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1968-11-06.StudioRehearsals.GEMS.82393.flac16**: taped by SBD DAT from the collection of Todd Evans; transferred by Editing and Mastering in Wavelab 6.0 by Jamie Waddell; source: Reel> PCM > DAT [1]. Also: Tim Constanten, not Pigpen, plays organ; band teaches him material; Source is 81+ minutes; longer than similar etree source [1][8]
- **gd1968-11-06.154387.studios.rehearsals.miller.t.flac16**: taped by Transferred by David Gans; transferred by Mastered by Charlie Miller  August 13, 2021; source: SBD > Master Reel (TC) > Cassette (Gans) [2]. Also: All circulating tapes trace back to this specific cassette [2]
- **gd1968-11-06.153017.sbd.gans.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Transferred by David Gans Mastered by Charlie Miller  August 13, 2021; source: SBD > Master Reel (TC) > Cassette (Gans) [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LUV4MUSIC!: [Spotlight On What I Am Listening To: Grateful Dead - Pacific High Recording, San Mateo, CA 1968-11-06 - LUV4MUSIC!](https://www.luv4music.org/2025/11/06/spotlight-on-what-i-am-listening-to-grateful-dead-pacific-high-recording-san-mateo-ca-1968-11-06/) [11]
